title: Taxi drivers protest over ₹350 entry fee at Bhogapuram airport

ai.summary: Taxi drivers in Andhra Pradesh protested near Bhogapuram airport on November 18, 2026, claiming a ₹350 entry fee for local taxis would increase their operating costs and passenger fares.

facts.claim: Taxi drivers staged a protest near Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, opposing an alleged ₹350 entry fee for local taxis.
facts.quote: HYDERABAD: Taxi drivers staged a protest near Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, opposing an alleged ₹350 entry fee for local taxis.

facts.claim: The drivers said authorities were asking them to pay ₹350 to enter the airport premises and pick up or drop off passengers.
facts.quote: The drivers said authorities were asking them to pay ₹350 to enter the airport premises and pick up or drop off passengers.

facts.claim: They argued that the charge would increase their operating costs and burden passengers.
facts.quote: They argued that the charge would increase their operating costs and burden passengers.

facts.claim: According to the protesting drivers, a taxi journey from Visakhapatnam to Bhogapuram airport costs around ₹1,000. If drivers pass on the entry fee to passengers, the total fare could increase to approximately ₹1,350.
facts.quote: According to the protesting drivers, a taxi journey from Visakhapatnam to Bhogapuram airport costs around ₹1,000. If drivers pass on the entry fee to passengers, the total fare could increase to approximately ₹1,350.

facts.claim: Bhogapuram airport lies around 45–50 km from Visakhapatnam via National Highway 16. Taxis remain an important transport option for passengers travelling between the city and the airport.
facts.quote: Bhogapuram airport lies around 45–50 km from Visakhapatnam via National Highway 16. Taxis remain an important transport option for passengers travelling between the city and the airport.

facts.claim: Taxi drivers staged a protest near Bhogapuram airport over an entry fee of ₹350 being charged to local taxis entering the airport premises.
facts.quote: Taxi drivers staged a protest near Bhogapuram airport over an entry fee of ₹350 being charged to local taxis entering the airport premises.

facts.claim: Drivers alleged that local taxis have to pay an additional ₹350 to enter the airport area.
facts.quote: Drivers alleged that local taxis have to pay an additional ₹350 to enter the airport area.

facts.claim: They said passengers travelling from Visakhapatnam to the airport are already paying ₹1,000 in taxi fares and now face an additional burden of ₹350.
facts.quote: They said passengers travelling from Visakhapatnam to the airport are already paying ₹1,000 in taxi fares and now face an additional burden of ₹350.
